title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
summary: Cloud in a Bottle is an open-source project that simplifies self-hosting by packaging complex cloud infrastructure into an easy-to-use solution, making it accessible to non-technical users who want to run their own servers and services.
problem_solved: Eliminates the technical complexity and steep learning curve that prevents average users from self-hosting their own cloud services.
why_valuable: It democratizes cloud infrastructure by empowering individuals to own and control their data without requiring DevOps expertise.
